## Activity

During March 2026, North City Eye Clinic recorded 614 captures. This figure represents the activity reported for the month and provides the basis for the image-quality and grading summary below.

The report records the number of captures completed at the site without introducing a separate attendance or appointment measure.

## Image quality

Of the 614 captures, 14 were ungradable. The reported ungradable rate was 2.3. The count and rate are presented together to show the scale of image-quality exclusions during March 2026.

## Grading

Grading identified 178 referable results from the activity recorded in March 2026. The median lag from capture to grading was 1. This is the reported measure for the interval between image capture and completion of grading.

Taken together, the figures provide the monthly operational picture for North City Eye Clinic: 614 captures, 14 ungradable captures, an ungradable rate of 2.3, 178 referable results, and a median lag of 1.
